label: hero v2
goal: Buy one Trail Backpack with standard delivery. Your details: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city Testville, ZIP 99999, country United States. Pay by card: name on card Alex Morgan, card number 4111 1111 1111 1111, expiry 12/30, security code 123. Agree to the terms of sale. You do not want newsletters or promotions.

outcome.reason: The order is confirmed by the payment oracle.

findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: A newsletter popup opened automatically on the cart page and grabbed keyboard focus into its Email field; I had to find Escape to close it, and I did not want it
After pressing Pay there was no announcement or visible change; the confirmation only showed up after I read the page again, so I did not know if the payment went through
Focus entered the embedded PayPal fields with generic names such as a div showing PayPal, and the card section had no clear heading or group, so it was unclear where the pay by card fields began
After activating Add to cart, focus stayed on the button and the status message was easy to miss; I had to go backwards to find the Cart link
Every page needs several Tab presses through header links before reaching the content, because focus starts at the top and the skip link only helps the first time

events.thought: Check whether the page changed after paying

events.result: You read the page again.

outcome.reason: The order is confirmed by the payment oracle.

findings.page: Your cart - Pine and Peak Outfitters
findings.problem: A newsletter popup opened automatically on the cart page and grabbed keyboard focus into its Email field; I had to find Escape to close it, and I did not want it
After pressing Pay there was no announcement or visible change; the confirmation only showed up after I read the page again, so I did not know if the payment went through
Focus entered the embedded PayPal fields with generic names such as a div showing PayPal, and the card section had no clear heading or group, so it was unclear where the pay by card fields began
After activating Add to cart, focus stayed on the button and the status message was easy to miss; I had to go backwards to find the Cart link
Every page needs several Tab presses through header links before reaching the content, because focus starts at the top and the skip link only helps the first time
